description: Search Console's top searches for the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 30), 50 at most, most clicks first: each query with its clicks, impressions, ctr (a share of 1, so 0.05 is 5%) and position (an average over the searches you appeared in, never a rank). connected says whether Search Console is connected, and lastSyncError appears when the last update from it failed. Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen) or while Search Console is not connected.
name: get_search_console_queries
